pages.title: Clay
pages.text: $(thing)점토$()는 굉장히 유용한 균형 잡힌 재료로, 도자기를 만드는 데 쓰일 수 있습니다. 점토를 처음으로 찾는 것은 쉬운 일이 아닐 수 있습니다. 점토는 일반적으로 잔디에 가려져 있지만, 다음의 장소에서 주로 발견됩니다. $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)연 강수량$()이 175mm 이상인 곳에서는 점토를 어디서나 찾을 수 있지만, 보통 특정 $(thing)식물이$() 점토의 위치를 나타냅니다.

pages.name: §l점토 표지 식물
pages.text: Clay, with the plants that may indicate its presence.

$(thing)개고사리$(), $(thing)칸나$(), $(thing)미역취$(), $(thing)팜파스풀$(), $(thing)러시안세이지$(), 그리고 $(thing)물칸나$()는 모두 근처에 점토가 있다는 것을 의미할 수도 있습니다. 점토는 보통 강이나 호수, 연못 등 물 근처에서 발견됩니다.$(br2)돌멩이와 같이, 점토는 쳐서 새로운 아이템을 만들 수 있습니다. 점토를 치기 위해서는 5개의 점토가 필요합니다. 돌멩이와는 달리, 만약 실수한다면 창을 닫았다 열어서 다시 처음으로 돌아갈 수 있습니다.
The Knapping Interface.

The small vessel is one such item. Like all pottery items, it must be $(l:https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pottery)fired$() before it can be used. Firing is a process of $(l:game_mechanics/heating)heating$() the item up to a point where the clay will turn into a hard $(thing)Ceramic$() material, which requires heating to 1400 °C, or $(e)$(bold)$(t:Yellow White)Yellow White$().$(br2)In order to do this in the early game, you will need to use a $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kiln$().
pages.title: §l작은 항아리

pages.text: Small Vessels can store items to save space in your inventory as well as $(l:cooking/decay#vessels)Preserving Food Items$(). Small vessels have a limit of 16 items per-slot and cannot fit items larger than $(l:game_mechanics/size_and_weight)"small"$().

Another useful pottery item is the $(thing)Jug$(). It can be used to pick up and $(thing)drink$() fluids, such as fresh water.$(br2)In order to use it, simply $(item)$(k:key.use)$() the jug on the fluid in the world. Then use the jug in order to drink from it. The jug is a $(l:cooking/drinking_containers)Drinking Container$() that can hold $(thing)100 mB$() of fluid at a time.
pages.title: §l주전자

pages.text: Clay is also necessary for making $(thing)Molds$(). Molds can have molten metal poured into them, which will eventually solidify into the shape of a mold. The item and potentially the mold can then be retrieved by using $(item)$(k:key.use)$() on the mold or putting it in your crafting grid.$(br2)All molds have a limit of not being able to contain molten metal past the bronze-age, $(thing)except ingot molds$().
pages.title: §l금형
Mold Types
pages.text: There are many different types of molds. The most useful of which are the $(item)Ingot$() and $(item)Tool Head$() molds.$(br)Ingot molds require $(thing)144mb$() of molten metal to produce one ingot.$(br)Tool head molds replace traditional stone knapping for tools and usually require $(thing)144mB$() of fluid, however some tool types may require less or more.

The mold then needs to be fired―like all clay items―to be usable, such as in a $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kiln$().$(br2)Once it is fired, molten metal can be poured in. Once the metal has cooled enough, it can be extracted.

pages.title: Casting
pages.text: You will very likely run into scenarios where you produce tiny amounts of excess melted metal. It is recommended to pour it into an ingot mold and save for the next time you need to cast that metal. Trying to produce perfect 144mB ratios of alloys is not feasible or worth the effort until you reach steam-age processing.

pages.title: Kaolin Clay
pages.text: Kaolin Clay is required to make $(l:craftsmanship/pottery#fire_clay)Fire Clay$(). It can be found spawning between Y=75-110 in Plateaus, Rolling Hills and Highlands (and in their $(t:Surface rock of Limestone, Dolomite, Chalk, or Marble)Karst$() $(t:Burren, Cenote, Doline, Shilin, or Tower Karst)variants$()), Old Mountains, and Shield Volcanoes at a $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 18°C, with a $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 300mm. The $(thing)Blood Lily$() flower grows on Kaolin clay, which can be up to 35 blocks below.
If you see the flower but there's no clay on the surface, dig deeper!

Unless you selected the $(item)Tropical$() climate when creating your world, the journey to obtaining Kaolin Clay may be long but is always a memorable part of TerraFirmaCraft. It is important to prepare for the trip, such as through $(l:logistics/exploration_gear)equipment$(), a $(l:logistics/boats)boat$(), $(l:logistics/personal_storage)extra storage$(), $(l:cooking/food_and_water)food and drink$(), and a $(item)Spade$() to dig it all up with.$(br2)Generally, go $(thing)South East$() to increase temperature and humidity to reach the ideal climates.

If you're not a fan of long journeys, get seasick easily, or are very unlucky, $(tfg_short) has another option for obtaining Kaolin Clay: visiting $(l:beneath/beneath)The Beneath$()! It requires less traveling but is far more dangerous... with the potential for even greater riches!

Kaolinite powder is made by heating $(l:craftsmanship/pottery#kaolin_clay)Kaolin Clay$(). However, the process is not perfect, and only 20% of clay will form powder!$(br2)In order to mass produce kaolinite powder early on, it is recommended to fill small vessels with kaolin clay blocks and then place these vessels in a $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kiln$() to cook on-site. With this method you can cook up to 1,024 kaolin clay at a time per pit kiln.

The amount of kaolinite powder you will need is enormous. If you have traveled very far to acquire kaolin clay and wish to make the most of your trip it is recommended to not return until you have at least 7 stacks (448 items) of $(n)Kaolinite Powder$(). This will ensure you have enough for a full-size $(l:craftsmanship/blast_furnace)Blast Furnace$(), $(l:craftsmanship/crucible)Crucibles$(), and molds. You should also bring back at least 20 blocks of kaolin clay for $(l:craftsmanship/glassworking)Glassworking$().

pages.title: Fire Clay
pages.text: The list of uses of fire clay is small, but all of them are important. Fire clay is a stronger variant of clay that has better heat resistance. It is used to make things that have to get very hot!

Fire clay is made from $(thing)Graphite$() crushed in a $(l:craftsmanship/quern)Quern$(), as well as $(l:craftsmanship/pottery#kaolinite_powder)Kaolinite Powder$().$(br2)Steam machines unlock more efficient ways to craft fire clay, so you may want to save some of your ingredients for later.
$(thing)Fire Ingot Molds$() are a stronger type of $(l:craftsmanship/pottery#mold)Ingot Mold$() that has just a 1 in 100 chance of breaking, compared to 1 in 10 for a regular ingot mold.
